technology_name: Ice Cream Preparation Using Sugarcane Syrup and Powder Jaggery
institution: ICAR-Sugarcane Breeding Institute Research Centre, Kannur
problem_solved: Dependence on refined sugar in ice cream production
description: This technology enables the preparation of ice cream using sugarcane syrup or powder jaggery as alternatives to refined sugar. The approach incorporates sugarcane-based sweeteners into frozen desserts while retaining the flavour characteristics and nutritional attributes associated with sugarcane products.
applications:
Ice cream and frozen dessert manufacturing companies
Dairy processing and value-added dairy product enterprises
Natural sweetener and clean-label food product manufacturers
Health food and specialty food brands
Farmer producer organizations (FPOs) and sugarcane-based agro-processing startups
